_comment: Player Setup preview BACKDROPS. See BACKDROP_AUTHORING.md in this folder.
This file is OPTIONAL. theme / transparent / gradient / grid are compiled into the client;
this file exists to retune their lighting and to add image backdrops.
Image assets MUST live under config\UI\PlayerPreview\Backdrops\ -- the client refuses any
other path, so a manifest can never be used to read a file elsewhere on the machine.
PNG, animated GIF and BMP are supported; an animated GIF plays on its own.
